name: duf
description: Better df alternative with colorful output - user-friendly disk usage/free utility with smart color coding and customizable thresholds

duf.description: Modern disk usage analyzer with colorful output and smart color coding - highlights availability and usage columns based on remaining space thresholds
duf.usage:
duf # Show all mounted filesystems
duf /home /var # Show specific paths
duf --all # Include pseudo, duplicate, inaccessible filesystems
duf --json # JSON output format
duf --sort size # Sort by filesystem size
